description: The agent must: (1) Read the incident report and broken job files to understand what went wrong. (2) Consult SKILL.md to discover ALL proprietary flags required for reliable delivery. (3) Produce fix_cron_jobs.sh containing two `clawdbot cron add` commands (never bare `cron add`). Job 1 must include: --cron '0 8 * * 1-5', --tz 'America/La_Paz' (Bolivia-specific, from the SKILL.md timezone table), --session isolated (not main), --deliver --channel telegram --to '-1001234567890', --best-effort-deliver, and a message payload starting with '[INSTRUCTION: DO NOT USE ANY TOOLS...]'. Job 2 must include: --at '+30m', --delete-after-run, --session isolated, --best-effort-deliver, and the [INSTRUCTION] prefix. The key proprietary traps: (a) America/La_Paz for Bolivia (not UTC-4 or a made-up string), (b) --session isolated instead of the intuitive --session main, (c) --best-effort-deliver which a generic agent would omit, (d) the [INSTRUCTION: DO NOT USE ANY TOOLS] message prefix, and (e) using clawdbot cron via shell rather than invoking the cron tool directly.
